title: Undo preserves pushed file deletions on the copy
steps: Run the real MariaDB shell flow through Preview, confirmed Apply delete, Undo and Preview again.
expect: Apply removes the live template file.
Undo restores the live file while the automatic sync keeps the copy deletion.
A later preview offers the same deletion again.

tests: a pushed template file deletion survives Undo and Sync on the copy and is offered again
